question: does max_edges=2500 protect anything, or reject figures the pipeline handles

why_synthesis_could_not_answer.verdict: diminishing returns 3.7x short of the gate; real 2500+ figures carry dense hatching and fine detail the compositor cannot produce

gate_off_run.cohort: 106 real figures gated by edge count alone (isolation<=0.3), 2508 to 52785 edges
readings: geometry validity does not degrade with edge count: 84%, 82%, 81%, 3/3
runtime is not the justification: the 8-20k band runs 4x faster than 2.5-4k
max_primitives (50000) catches the 14 genuinely oversized cases on its own, including the 52785-edge figure; the audit called it dormant, it was shadowed
gate_off_run.cost_of_the_gate: 10.6% of the corpus (106 per 1000 in the F1 dry run)

decision.by: owner, 2026-09-21, on a 7-figure montage from 2995 to 31307 edges
decision.outcome: max_edges: null in config_deploy.yaml and config_deploy_gpu.yaml; max_primitives is the sole budget guard
